feature: Toppan Download: file balikan registered mail RD2 (nomor registrasi pos) disimpan ke tabel tracking RD2
story: Tidak ada di chunk OCMS11.31-11.35 (terkait 2nd letter RD2)
note: Setelah 2nd letter RD2 dikirim, job Toppan Download membaca file balikan DPT-URA-RD2-D2-* dan menyimpan nomor registrasi pos (postal_regn_no) ke ocms_request_driver_particulars, serta memproses transisi stage RD2 ke RR3 dari file ack. Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menyebut nomor registrasi pos; mungkin dicakup story Toppan download/ack lain. Belum dipastikan ke story mana.
note_en: After the RD2 2nd letter is sent, the Toppan Download job reads the DPT-URA-RD2-D2-* return file and saves the postal registration number (postal_regn_no) to ocms_request_driver_particulars, and processes the RD2 to RR3 stage transition from the ack file. No story in this chunk mentions the postal registration number; it may be covered by another Toppan download/ack story. The matching story is not confirmed.
